base_template.name: Basic Tailwind CSS Template
base_template.html:
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
</head>

<body class="bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-sans leading-normal tracking-normal">

        {% block content %}        
        {% endblock %}


</body>

</html>

template.name: Client System Capacity (html)
template.template_variables:
data_sources:
  agents:
    filter:
      site__client_id: '{{client.id}}'
    model: agent
    only:
      - hostname
      - wmi_detail
      - total_ram
      - disks
report_run_timestamp: !now
